newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury sees PSBR factors unwinding this year.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury sees PSBR factors unwinding this year.

text.p: Britain's public sector borrowing requirement in June was boosted by changes in the timing of government debt interest payments and in corporate VAT payments but these effects will unwind over the course of the year, the British Treasury said on Wednesday.

"As foreseen in last month's PSBR press release, changes to the timing of interest payments on government debt and to large companies' VAT payments boosted borrowing by over two billion stg compared to last June," a Treasury official said.
"These effects will unwind over the rest of the year," he said.
The June PSBR was 4.754 billion stg, compared with a revised May PSBR of 3.734 billion stg.
